name: carousel-render
description: Sub-workflow: renders a carousel (brand + carousel JSON + carouselId) into named JPG/PNG files via Cloudflare Browser Rendering. Called by carousel-render-test and, later, carousel-generator-main.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ html: $json.html, viewport: { width: 1080, height: 1350 }, gotoOptions: { waitUntil: "networkidle0" }, waitForSelector: { selector: "body.ready", timeout: 15000 }, screenshotOptions: $json.format === "png" ? { type: "png" } : { type: "jpeg", quality: 92 } }) }}
